title: The Prouhet--Tarry--Escott problem for subsets with small doubling in integral domains
summary: The Prouhet--Tarry--Escott (PTE) problem has many generalizations and has been studied in various algebraic domains. In this paper, we prove that finite subsets $S$ of integral domains with small additive doubling constant (but still a power of $|S|$) always contain solutions to Wright's generalization of the PTE problem: there are small subsets $A$ and $B$ of the same size such that $\sum_{a\in A} a^j=\sum_{b\in B} b^j$ for $1\le j\le k$, but not for $j=k+1$.
